AXONIUS PLATFORM
Identities
Discover every identity – human and machine – and connect each one to the devices, apps, and exposures it touches. Identity risk only makes sense in full asset context.
Request a Demo
The world’s top companies rely on Axonius
Identity tools see artifacts. Axonius sees the full risk picture.
Identities extends asset intelligence to every human and non-human identity across your environment. By correlating identities with devices, SaaS apps, cloud workloads, and exposures, teams can see which access paths create real risk – and close gaps that identity-only tools miss.
Continuous Identity Discovery
Every identity, every system, always current
Discover all human and non-human identities – service accounts, API keys, automation identities – across directories, cloud, SaaS, and infrastructure. No blind spots from identity sprawl.
Identity-to-Asset Correlation
See who touches what, and what's at risk
Map every identity to the devices it uses, applications it accesses, and exposures it creates. Surface attack paths that only become visible when identity and asset context are combined.
Identity Posture & Hygiene
Catch the gaps other tools miss
Detect MFA gaps, excessive privileges, stale accounts, orphaned identities, and risky access patterns – prioritized by real exposure and asset impact, not just policy violations in isolation.
Enforcement & Remediation
Close gaps across systems, not just directories
Disable accounts, revoke access, trigger remediation tickets, and enforce policies across the full environment – not limited to a single identity provider or directory.
Ready to take action across your identity footprint?
Schedule a personalized demo with an Axonius specialist.
Contact Sales
Key Differentiators
Identity risk grounded in asset intelligence – every identity connected to the devices, apps, and exposures that make access dangerous.
Identity as an asset class, not a silo
Identities isn't a standalone IGA tool – it extends asset intelligence so identity context enriches every security program you already run on Axonius.
Cross-domain risk no identity tool sees
Identity tools evaluate access in isolation. Axonius correlates identity with device posture, SaaS exposure, cloud workloads, and vulnerabilities.
Human and machine identities, one model
Service accounts, API keys, and automation identities evaluated with the same intelligence model as human identities — no separate tooling required.
Strengthens your IAM stack, doesn't replace it
Axonius feeds clean, correlated identity data back into your IAM, IGA, and PAM tools – making governance more accurate and enforcement more effective.
